description: Free-text answers to "What would you tell a colleague about the product?", passed as prose: words are counted and common English stopwords dropped.
data:
The new dashboard is fast and the setup was painless. Setup took ten minutes, and the dashboard loaded instantly on every machine we tried.
Support answered within an hour. Pricing is fair for small teams but the pricing page is confusing about seats.
The export to CSV is great; export to PDF is missing and we need PDF reports for the board. Reports are the reason we bought it.
Search is slow on large projects. Search results also ignore archived projects, which surprised the whole team.
Notifications are noisy: too many emails, and the email digest cannot be scheduled. Please let us schedule the digest.
Mobile app crashes when opening large reports. The mobile app is otherwise fast and the offline mode works.
Onboarding was smooth and the templates saved us days. Templates for weekly reports would be even better.
Integrations with Slack and GitHub work well; the Jira integration loses comments. Fix the Jira sync please.
Overall the dashboard, the reports and the support team are why we renewed. Pricing and search are what we would change.
